body.message:
Please note that if you wish to secure the booking today, the payment will need to be completed by card.

Alternatively, we can release the unit for today, and you may complete the deposit payment by bank transfer tomorrow. Once we receive confirmation from our Finance team, we can block the unit and reinstate the booking for you.

Please note that in this case, the unit will remain subject to availability, and we cannot guarantee that it will still be available tomorrow.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation
